title: The licensing surface - gated installs and creator attribution
description:
Consolidation sweep 2026-08-10: MPI-357 and MPI-358 both turn third-party licence metadata into app behaviour and both land in the Model Library. Same sources (Hugging Face, CivitAI by-hash), same VPN constraint, same UI surface.

DISSOLVED 2026-08-21: MPI-534 was rejected+archived and MPI-357 shipped, leaving ONE live member (MPI-358). Its own plan says to delete the umbrella when the members are the better unit. MPI-358 continues as a solo card - it keeps the VPN/clock constraint the umbrella carried.
